claims.claim: L3Harris Q2 2026 issuer results reported $7.3 billion of orders, 1.2x book-to-bill and record $42 billion backlog, with growth across all operating segments and increased full-year revenue and EPS guidance.

risks.risk: Backlog quality depends on program execution, funding and conversion timing; funded and unfunded awards are included in orders.

unknowns.unknown: Alpha must normalize portfolio transactions and non-operating gains before scoring durable operating momentum.

claims.claim: Q2 execution included $5.9 billion revenue, 11.1% operating margin, $879 million operating cash flow and $771 million free cash flow; separately, the $1 billion government investment in Missile Solutions closed in April to fund capacity expansion ahead of a planned second-half-2026 IPO, subject to market conditions.

risks.risk: Missile Solutions IPO timing is market-dependent and the transaction changes future portfolio economics and comparability.

unknowns.unknown: Post-IPO ownership, valuation and consolidated economics require Alpha underwriting when transaction terms are final.
